1.asv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

2.web: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
2.asv: Can a man be profitable unto God? Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.

3.web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?
3.asv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gainto him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

4.web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
4.asv: Is it for thy fear of him that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?

5.web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
5.asv: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.

6.web: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
6.asv: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

7.web: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
7.asv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

8.web: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
8.asv: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.

9.web: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
9.asv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

10.web: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
10.asv: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee,

11.web: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
11.asv: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

12.web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
12.asv: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

13.web: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
13.asv: And thou sayest, What doth God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

14.web: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
14.asv: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not; And he walketh on the vault of heaven.

15.web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
15.asv: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

16.web: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
16.asv: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

17.web: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
17.asv: Who said unto God, Depart from us; And, What can the Almighty do for us?

18.web: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
18.asv: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

19.web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
19.asv: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,

20.web: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
20.asv: Saying, Surely they that did rise up against us are cut off, And the remnant of them the fire hath consumed.

21.web: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.
21.asv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.

22.web: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
22.asv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thy heart.

23.web: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
23.asv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents.

24.web: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
24.asv: And lay thou thy treasure in the dust, Andthe gold ofOphir among the stones of the brooks;

25.web: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
25.asv: And the Almighty will be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee.

26.web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.
26.asv: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

27.web: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.
27.asv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee; And thou shalt pay thy vows.

28.web: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.
28.asv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; And light shall shine upon thy ways.

29.web: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
29.asv: When they casttheedown, thou shalt say, There is lifting up; And the humble person he will save.

30.web: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
30.asv: He will deliverevenhim that is not innocent: Yea, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.
